title: A must on your trip to Barcelona.
text: The guided tour of Park Güell was an excellent experience. Oliver was a very kind and attentive guide; he explained the history and details of the park in an interesting and enjoyable way, and made the tour even more special. We really enjoyed getting to know this iconic place in Barcelona. Highly recommended!
